failed_candidates: <plan>We start with 4 saplings (wood) and no crafted items. Our immediate goal is to earn the “Place Table” achievement, which also gives us a surface to craft tools. We will place a table on the grass tile directly in front of us. After the table is placed we can craft a wood pickaxe (needs wood and a table) to later mine stone, and a wood sword (needs wood and a table) for combat. Before crafting we should collect wood to satisfy the “Collect Wood” achievement; this can be done by using the Do action on a sapling tile (or the grass if it yields wood). Once we have wood collected, we place the table, then craft the wood pickaxe and wood sword. With the pickaxe we can mine stone (to get “Collect Stone” and later “Place Stone”), then collect coal and iron by mining appropriate nodes, craft a furnace, and progress to stone and iron tools, defeat zombies and skeletons, eat plants/cow, collect drink from water, and finally aim for diamonds. Throughout we will manage health, food, drink, and energy, sleeping when low. The first concrete step is to place the table on the grass in front to secure the “Place Table” achievement.\n<action>Place Table</action>
